answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 25435 Country: India Title: I have fracture on my both ankle due to which i can,t sit while doing toilet & thus i am not able to wash my penis so can i keep fast in such condition ? Question: assalam-o-alaikum i have fracture on my both ankle due to which i can,t sit while doing toilet & thus i am not able to wash my penis so can i keep fast in such condition Answer ID: 25435 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1475/1132/D=1431) Yes, you can keep fast in this condition. Hadas asghar (minor impurity i.e. passing wind, urine and stool) will not bar to keep fast. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
